title: DIRE for Diffusion-Generated Image Detection
role: Evidence that a classifier on a residual computed along a deterministic DDIM inversion path reads provenance (on or off the model's manifold) almost perfectly; a confound and a seed-free path recipe for a score-path encoder.
reads: Clean RGB image x0; DIRE = |x0 - R(I(x0))|, the absolute pixel residual after 20-step DDIM inversion and reconstruction with an unconditional ADM trained on LSUN-Bedroom.
trains: Only a ResNet-50 binary classifier on DIRE images with binary cross-entropy; 40k real vs 40k ADM-generated LSUN-Bedroom images; diffusion model frozen; training length not stated.
combines: No combination across conditions; one unconditional eps_theta drives deterministic DDIM inversion (Eq. 8) and reconstruction (Eq. 5, sigma_t = 0); input compared with its round trip in pixel space.
noise_and_seed: No noise is sampled (deterministic DDIM), so no seed; run-to-run variance not reported; nonzero DIRE attributed, without measurement, to ODE discretization error that is larger for real images.
timesteps: not measured per timestep; more DDIM steps help on Stable Diffusion v1 (accuracy 87.5% at S = 5 to 99.9% at S = 50).
unseen: no: no held-out concepts; held-out generators (7 unseen bedroom generators, ImageNet ADM and SD-v1, StyleGAN) with 90.2 to 100% accuracy.
headline: Mean accuracy / AP over 8 test generators 99.9% / 100% (higher better) for DIRE trained on ADM vs 91.6% / 97.7% for retrained F3Net; ADM on LSUN-Bedroom reconstructs, ResNet-50 classifies.
suggests: (inferred) A score-path encoder may learn manifold membership before concept, so PoE and joint paths need a realism-matched control; computing paths along deterministic inversion of the final canvas removes the seed.
model: ADM (unconditional, LSUN-Bedroom) as reconstruction model; generators include ADM, DDPM, iDDPM, PNDM, LDM, SD-v1, SD-v2, VQ-Diffusion, StyleGAN

disagreements.claim: The detector never sees GAN images in training
disagreements.paper_says: p. 7 says the classifier never encounters any GAN-generated image during training, but Tables 2 and 3 include a detector trained on StyleGAN images, and the StyleGAN test column includes that row.

disagreements.claim: Which generators were compared for the generation and reconstruction choice
disagreements.paper_says: p. 6 says three generation models were selected (PNDM, iDDPM, StyleGAN) while Table 2 reports four, including ADM.
